{{Top|leg}}
The '''missile deactivation transmitter''' was a countermeasure developed by the [[Galactic Alliance Army]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Swarm War]]. These transmitters were able to detect the guiding frequencies used by enemy [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and warheads. They were then capable of sending a signal to deactivate the projectiles before damaging an Alliance [[Warship/Legends|warship]].
